optimizedDescription.value: ValidateSpecs-specific port memoizing per-spec validation outcomes with workspace-scoped freshness cascade over SpecRepository.

optimizedContext.value:
# ValidationResultCache Port

## Rules

- Abstract class `ValidationResultCache` in `application/ports/`. Concrete behaviour only in infrastructure adapters.
- Each instance bound to one workspace identity for lifetime. Multi-workspace use cases get one instance per workspace (or workspace-keyed registry).
- Receive workspace `SpecRepository` (same identity) at construction via composition; MUST NOT pass repository on every `lookup`/`upsert`. Injected `workspace()` MUST match cache workspace. Adapters MAY also receive storage/path deps. Use contractual `list({ includeMeta: true })` / `get()` / `specFingerprint()` / raw metadata bytes — MUST NOT invent `validationSourceStamps` / `readValidationSidecar` helpers.
- Cached entry = `SpecValidationEntry`: `spec` (`workspace:capabilityPath`), `passed`, `failures`, `warnings`. Persist pass and fail alike; omit failures/warnings NOT permitted.
- Bucket validity before any row: `schemaFingerprint`, `engineVersion`, invalidation flag equivalent to list-index `isInvalidated`. Failed validity → every lookup miss until bucket rebuilt/rewritten.
- Stored row retains: stamps from `Spec` via `get()` — `SpecArtifactEntry.lastModified` per present artifact, `persistedStateStamp.{present,lastModified}`, `generatedMetadataStamp.{present,lastModified}`; plus `cacheFingerprint` opaque digest computed by this port.
- `cacheFingerprint` = content hash of sorted-key JSON `{ specFingerprint, metadataContentHash }` where `specFingerprint` from `SpecRepository.specFingerprint(spec)` (artifacts + persisted-state hash via `persistedStateMeta({ includeHash: true })`; never metadata); `metadataContentHash` = hash of raw `metadata.json` bytes or literal `"__absent__"`. MUST NOT invent third flat fingerprint.
- `lookup` owns freshness: (1) bucket invalid → miss; (2) use `input.stamps` if provided else `get()` stamps (no artifact content reads); (3) stamps match → hard hit without `cacheFingerprint`; (4) stamps differ → compute `cacheFingerprint`; match → soft hit: persist refreshed stamps without changing fingerprint/entry; (5) else miss. Soft-hit refresh NOT exposed to callers.
- Methods: `workspace(): string`; `lookup({ spec, schemaFingerprint, engineVersion, stamps? })` → `{ kind: 'hit', entry } | { kind: 'miss' }`; `upsert({ entry, spec, schemaFingerprint, engineVersion })`. MUST NOT accept `cacheFingerprint`, `refreshStamps`, or repository arg.
- After full validation miss, `ValidateSpecs` calls `upsert` with entry/spec/bucket inputs only; cache materializes stamps + fingerprint via injected repo.
- Delivery hosts MUST NOT depend on this port. Composition MAY wire into `ValidateSpecs` only. Public host APIs MUST NOT expose cache controls/paths/flags.
- MUST NOT implement as hidden concern inside `SpecRepository` list/count helpers or `FsSpecIndexCache`.

## Constraints

- Lives in `application/ports/` per hexagonal rules.
- Export from curated `@specd/core/ports` barrel (`packages/core/src/ports.ts`).
- Adapters treat cache storage as runtime state, not committed project content.
- Methods MUST NOT perform schema rule evaluation; store/retrieve outcomes and evaluate freshness only.
- ValidateSpecs-specific; MAY know ValidateSpecs freshness model.
